evidence: Two main packages ('model' and 'workflow') indicate logical grouping of concerns
Each workflow directly imports and orchestrates a specific model class (e.g., 'cf_workflow' imports 'UserCf')
No explicit interface/adapter layer between layers; workflows depend directly on models
Shared 'preprocess.py' is a flat module outside the main package structure
Centralized entry point 'manage.py' that imports and likely invokes workflows
Repository tree shows bounded modules with minimal cross-dependency and no external service boundaries
fan_out of 2.2 and minimal depth (2) consistent with cohesive internal modules
risks: Tight coupling between workflow and model layers reduces testability and maintainability
Lack of explicit data/protocol interfaces (ports) makes substitution harder
Flat module structure in root ('preprocess.py', 'manage.py') may become a monolithic utility bottleneck
